claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User generates bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical reimbursement reports based on validated claims to enable the MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for VSPs.

goal.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User generates bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical reimbursement reports based on validated claims to enable the MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for VSPs.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
Claims must be collected from the VSP and submitted to the MSIU Field Office.
Submitted claims must have all mandatory information complete; otherwise, the system will not accept them.
Claims must be validated manually and through the system by the field office before report generation.
Payment terms (bi-monthly or monthly) must be agreed upon with the VSP as this determines the reporting cycle.
Only clean claims (or those designated for withholding pending clarification) are included in the respective reimbursement reports.
The MSIU Field Office User generates bi-monthly or monthly provider reimbursement reports based on the agreed payment terms with the VSP after claims have been collected and validated.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User generates bi-monthly or monthly provider reimbursement reports based on the agreed payment terms with the VSP after claims have been collected and validated.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User validates each claim form manually and through the system.
If mandatory information is missing or false information exists, the field office rejects the claim back to the VSP and the system places it in a quarantine area.
Quarantined forms are sent back to the VSP for verification; if the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims are entered into the system in the following month’s batch.
Based on the payment terms agreed upon with the VSP (bi-monthly or monthly), the field office generates the corresponding financial and medical reimbursement report.
The generated report is sent to the MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for the VSP.
If mandatory information is missing or false information exists during validation, the field office rejects the claim back to the VSP and the system places it in a quarantine area.
Quarantined forms are sent back to the VSP for verification; if the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims are entered into the system in the following month’s batch.
Reports may be generated monthly on claims where payment shall be withheld until clarification, representing an alternative reporting path for disputed or incomplete claims.

If mandatory information is missing or false information exists during validation, the field office rejects the claim back to the VSP and the system places it in a quarantine area; quarantined forms are sent back to the VSP for verification, and if the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims are entered into the system in the following month’s batch.
If the claim status is not 'Accepted' due to false data or missing mandatory information, the claim is stored in the quarantine area and cannot proceed further until its status changes.
If the same VSP has more than two instances of thumb impression mismatches for the same patient on the same voucher, the system automatically produces a warning message and inactivates the VSP.
Reports may be generated monthly for claims where payment shall be withheld until clarification, representing an exception path for disputed or incomplete claims.
The generated bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical reimbursement report is sent to the MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for the VSP.
Reports include monthly summaries of clean claims to be paid without reservation.
Reports include monthly summaries of claims where payment shall be withheld until clarification.
A report on claims per provider is generated as part of the output.
